lines.sub: Weekly report. Week of 8 to 14 November.
lines.say: Weekly report. The week of November eighth to fourteenth.

lines.sub: This week, the same beer went up 43% at one supermarket…
lines.say: This week, the same beer went up forty three percent at one supermarket.

lines.sub: …and down 21% at another.
lines.say: And down twenty one at another.

lines.sub: And still, groceries overall barely moved. Let's go step by step.
lines.say: And still, groceries overall barely moved. Let's take it step by step.

lines.sub: Every product, against its price the week before (1 to 7 November).
lines.say: We compare every product against its price the week before, November first to seventh.

lines.sub: 965 products compared.
lines.say: Nine hundred and sixty five products.

lines.sub: Result: −0.11%. Basically flat.
lines.say: The result: down zero point one one percent. Basically flat.

lines.sub: Without deals, at the list price: −0.48%.
lines.say: Without deals, at the list price, down zero point four eight.

lines.sub: 243 went up. 139 went down. 583 stayed the same.
lines.say: Two hundred and forty three products went up. One hundred and thirty nine went down. And five hundred and eighty three stayed the same.

lines.sub: Day to day it jumps with the deals. Over the whole week, almost nothing.
lines.say: Day to day, the index jumps around with the deals. But over the whole week, almost nothing.

lines.sub: Index groups that rose most: other food, +1.8%. Alcoholic drinks, +1.6%.
lines.say: Among the index groups, the biggest rise was other food, one point eight percent. And alcoholic drinks, one point six.

lines.sub: The biggest fall: vegetables. −6.1% in one week.
lines.say: The biggest fall: vegetables. Six percent cheaper, in a single week.

lines.sub: Beef, the biggest part of the basket: unchanged (−0.01%).
lines.say: And beef, the biggest part of the basket, didn't move.

lines.sub: Biggest rise: Elegante toilet paper, 4 rolls, at Carrefour. +50%.
lines.say: The product that rose most: Elegante toilet paper, four rolls, at Carrefour. From four thousand five hundred pesos, to six thousand eight hundred. Fifty percent.

lines.sub: But its list price rose only 7%. The rest: a deal that ended.
lines.say: But careful. Its list price rose only seven percent. The rest was a deal that ended.

lines.sub: Colgate toothpaste at Día: +44%. List price almost the same. Another deal gone.
lines.say: Colgate toothpaste, at Dee-ah: up forty four percent. And its list price, almost the same. Another deal gone.

lines.sub: On the other side, onions: −26% for the bag of 4 and −20% per kilo, at Carrefour.
lines.say: On the other side, onions. At Carrefour, the bag of four fell twenty six percent. And onions by the kilo, twenty.

lines.sub: Nobleza Gaucha yerba mate, 500 g, at Día: −23%.
lines.say: And Nobleza Gaucha yerba mate, half a kilo, at Dee-ah, twenty three percent cheaper.

lines.sub: Now, the beer. Warsteiner, 473 ml can. Same barcode.
lines.say: Now, the beer. Warsteiner, the four hundred and seventy three milliliter can. Same barcode.

lines.sub: Carrefour: from $2,290 to $3,286. +43%.
lines.say: At Carrefour it went from two thousand two hundred and ninety pesos, to three thousand two hundred and eighty six. Up forty three percent.
At Dee-ah, the same can fell from three thousand and sixty, to two thousand four hundred. Down twenty one.

lines.sub: The week before, Carrefour was cheaper. This week, Día.
lines.say: The week before, Carrefour was the better deal. This week, Dee-ah.

lines.sub: If you always shop in the same place, you miss it.
lines.say: If you always shop in the same place, you miss it.

lines.sub: Which chain rose most? Carrefour: +0.49%. The others fell a little.
lines.say: Which chain rose the most? Carrefour. Up zero point four nine percent. The others fell a little.

lines.sub: A clue: Carrefour had fewer deals. From 55 products on offer per day, to 42.
lines.say: A clue: Carrefour had fewer deals. From fifty five products on offer per day, down to forty two.

lines.sub: Ranking: the same 296 products. Día, cheapest again.
lines.say: And the ranking. For the same two hundred and ninety six products, Dee-ah was the cheapest again.

lines.sub: Jumbo: 17.5% more for the same.
lines.say: Jumbo, seventeen and a half percent more expensive, for exactly the same.

lines.sub: In short: a flat week, cheaper vegetables, and deals that come and go.
lines.say: In short. A flat week, cheaper vegetables, and deals that come and go.

lines.sub: December 1: Argentina's supermarket inflation for November.
lines.say: On December first, the November report comes out. Argentina's supermarket inflation for the month.

lines.sub: A new report every Sunday. Subscribe. Data at lacanastaindex.com
lines.say: And every Sunday, a new weekly report. Subscribe. All the data is at la canasta index dot com.
